  • Tittabawassee Ojibwe communities↗Historical regional community connection
    Connection & source
    Historical regional community connection

    Blackbird’s selected first-person passage names the Tittabawassee as a Saginaw tributary and describes riverside camps. Present Saginaw Chippewa sources and the FWS restoration account supply broader community/watershed context, not an exclusive descent chain or precise territory. Michigan listing is a regional reading route; no sensitive locations or boundary asserted.

    Nineteenth-century river accounts; present watershed context separately described. Reviewed 2026-10-25.

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
